candidates.title: Draft a travel request and purchase review table

ease.reason: A fictional request form can feed a draft table; n8n documents moving and transforming data between apps, but no travel rules or form are supplied.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: an office may value less manual travel purchasing; this vacancy shows human work, not demand for an AI service.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock can turn operator-entered fictional requests into a review table; n8n supports data movement, while approvals and purchasing stay manual.

autonomy.reason: A repeatable draft table is plausible with n8n data flows; a person must check policy, authorize every purchase and place orders.

evidence.reason: The fresh notice names travel orders and purchases; n8n documents general data transformation, with no evidence of travel workflow use or AI buyers.

candidates.reason: Assessed a bounded fictional-input experiment: collect operator-entered travel request details and draft a review table. n8n supports general data transformation, but the notice gives no fields, policy rules or cadence; staff must approve and place orders. The five criteria average 4.6, below the threshold of 6.

rejected.title: Paid administrator role
rejected.reason: The fresh notice identifies only an administrator role and contains no concrete task excerpt. A specific chore or useful experiment would require inventing duties.

steps.message: Assessed both selected professional_services leads. The notice with no task detail was excluded; the travel-orders and purchases chore was scoped as a fictional-input draft review table and scored 4.6 across the five criteria, below threshold 6. No post proposed.
